psychological_meaning: Spectra evokes feelings of tranquility, stability, and growth. It blends the calming aspects of blue with the revitalizing qualities of green, creating a balanced and harmonious effect. This color is often associated with nature, health, and renewal, promoting a sense of peace and well-being.
